about.title: Discover the Future of Cooking
about.subtitle: My Recette connects home cooks with local supermarkets, making recipe discovery and grocery shopping seamless, social, and smart.
about.storyBody: My Recette was born from a simple idea: what if finding the perfect recipe and the ingredients to make it were just as easy as the cooking itself? We created a platform where home cooks can discover new recipes, check real-time ingredient availability at nearby supermarkets, and purchase everything they need — all in one place. No more abandoned recipes because you're missing one ingredient. No more driving from store to store. Just great food, made simple.
about.value1Body: We start with amazing recipes from real cooks, then connect you with the stores that have the ingredients you need.
about.value2Body: We help supermarkets reach more customers and sell more products, while giving you access to the best local options.
about.value3Body: See real prices from multiple supermarkets, compare options, and find the best deals on quality ingredients.
about.value4Body: Share your favorite recipes, learn from other cooks, and build connections through the food we love.
about.value5Body: Create shopping lists from recipes, track what you need, and even get recommendations based on what's in season or on sale.
about.value6Body: Your data is yours. We protect your information and never share it without your permission.
about.step1Body: Browse thousands of recipes from our community. Filter by cuisine, dietary needs, cooking time, or ingredients you already have.
about.step2Body: See which local supermarkets have the ingredients you need, compare prices, and check for substitutes.
about.step3Body: Add everything to your cart and checkout. Pick up in-store or have it delivered. It's that simple.
about.readyBody: Join thousands of home cooks who are discovering new recipes, supporting local supermarkets, and making mealtime easier with My Recette.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Learn how we protect your data and respect your privacy on My Recette
privacy.introParagraph1: At My Recette, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our recipe discovery and shopping platform.
privacy.introParagraph2: By using My Recette, you agree to the terms outlined in this privacy policy. We encourage you to read it carefully.
privacy.informationContent: We collect information you provide directly (such as your name, email, and recipe preferences) as well as information collected automatically (like your IP address and browsing behavior) to improve your experience.
privacy.dataContent: Your data helps us personalize recipe recommendations, connect you with local supermarkets, process your orders, and improve our platform. We never sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use cookies to enhance your experience, analyze site traffic, and understand where our visitors are coming from. You can manage your cookie preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.thirdPartyContent: We use trusted third-party services for payments (Stripe), authentication, and analytics. These services have their own privacy policies that you should review.
privacy.securityContent: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. All payment information is encrypted and handled by our payment processor, not stored on our servers.
privacy.rightsContent: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You can also opt out of marketing communications at any time.
privacy.changesContent: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes via email or a notice on our platform.
privacy.contactContent: If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@myrecette.com.
privacy.supermarketContent: As a supermarket partner, your store information and inventory data may be visible to users. We treat your business data with the same care as user data and only share what's necessary for users to find and purchase your products.
privacy.questionsContent: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please don't hesitate to reach out.
